parts.title: Task 1
parts.passage_text:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The bar chart shows the percentage of dependents in five different countries around the world in 2000 and 2050.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

parts.title: Task 2
parts.passage_text: It is not necessary for students to go to school because more and more information is accessible on the Internet. Instead, children can study at home. Do you agree or disagree?
